neighbours.label: reporting a statistical comparison result in a study, especially a null or small difference (vs. ... p = 0.3; however, the difference was not significant; found no effect), as against the same connectives in everyday narration
fire: Body weight was similar in both arms (71.3 vs. 72.0 kg; p = 0.6).
Pain scores fell in the yoga group. However, the difference from controls was not significant.
Two large cohort studies found no association between coffee and stroke.
Mortality was slightly lower with the new drug, but the reduction did not reach significance.
At twelve months there was no difference in reading scores between the two schools.
Smokers had more infections than non-smokers (18% versus 15%, P = 0.21).
The pooled analysis of five trials showed no benefit of fish oil on memory.
Recovery time was shorter after keyhole surgery; however, this difference was small.
quiet: Body weight was the first thing the nurse checked when we arrived.
We planned to walk to the lake. However, the path was flooded after the storm.
Two large dogs ran across the road and into the field.
The new café was busy on Saturday, but the old one was empty.
At twelve months the baby could already say a few words.
My uncle smoked for years before he finally gave up last winter.
The five of us went fishing and caught nothing all day.
The drive home was shorter than usual; however, the traffic was heavy.
